## Engineering Work Graph for Tracing Agentic Workflows


Garrett VanLee


November 20, 2026


Rescale’s engineering work graph connects engineering work, data, and knowledge across projects. The graph establishes relationships between users, data, and tasks and has a human-readable view, providing insight into how agents use the context to improve answers, agentic workflows and decisions. The graph helps practitioners and leaders understand and verify the data relationships and context that ultimately help speed agent-led engineering work and decision making.


[Learn more](https://rescale.com/platform/agentic-engineering) about how engineering teams build and manage agentic workflows on Rescale.
